Name: (CP-AT) Animal Crossing Plushies
Author: xyariaa
Description:
Ever wanted to fill your house with plushies representing animal crossing villagers? Now you can!

         *Mod content*
╰──────༺♡༻──────╯[/size]
This mod contains all AC villagers that ever existed, from all games, in a small plushie form. They are all here, even Amiibo exclusive villagers!
For the Content Patcher version, they are available in the standard furniture catalogue.
For the Alternative Texture version, they are variations of the "Futan Bear" decoration you can find in the standard furniture catalogue.

[b][size=4]/!\[/size][/b] Please note that, while the CP mod has all villagers names translated into every available language, that's not the case for the AT mod (due to framework limitation). Villagers have their english name only.

This mod exist in both CP and AT version; you can find both version in the "Files" tab. Please only install one of them!

If you find any bug, please let me know!
